SELECT s.format, s.store_id, COUNT(*) AS nrows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, MIN(f.sale_date), MAX(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category, s.store_id, s.format, f.sale_date, f.quantity
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900)
SELECT 'staff' k, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), SUM(net_amount) FROM l WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'test', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), SUM(net_amount) FROM l WHERE category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_qty_or_amt', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), SUM(net_amount) FROM l WHERE quantity<=0 OR net_amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_fmt', COUNT(*), 0, 0 FROM l WHERE format IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipt_multi_store', COUNT(*),0,0 FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT store_id)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipt_mixed_staff', COUNT(*),0,0 FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'p4 dates', COUNT(*), 0, 0 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_multi_format', COUNT(*),0,0 FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT format)>1)

WITH l AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_b4
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_b4, MIN(business_date) mn, MAX(business_date) mx, COUNT(*) n
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.store_id, l.net_b4, r.rpt_b4, l.net_b4-r.rpt_b4 AS diff, r.n FROM l FULL JOIN r USING (store_id) WHERE abs(coalesce(l.net_b4,0)-coalesce(r.rpt_b4,0))>0.01 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format
